text: Timeline view in the security camera app. Timeline view in the security camera app. Add a timeline to the security camera app so I can jump to motion events. Scrolling through a full day of video is no fun.

Student can't download own transcript. Student can't download own transcript. Looks like a bug: the button gives "Error 13: not authorised" for the student's own transcript if their name was changed last year. Registrar can download it for them, but that takes days.

Barcode scanning in the mobile inventory app. Barcode scanning in the mobile inventory app. Staff want to use the phone camera for scanning shelf labels rather than typing product codes on that tiny keyboard. It saves a lot of time.
Tip the driver after delivery. Tip the driver after delivery. Let customers leave a tip after the food arrives, not only at checkout.

Promo banner covers checkout button on tablets. Promo banner covers checkout button on tablets. On a tablet in landscape our summer promo banner sits right on top of Place Order. You can only reach that button by turning your device, and I am sure many customers simply leave instead of trying that.

Load example button fills wrong fields. Load example button fills wrong fields. Load example button on import page puts dates into name column. Docs show how it should look, so it's this button that is broken.

Password manager friendly login fields. Password manager friendly login fields. Our testers noted the form has no autocomplete attributes, so password managers are not offering to fill it. A small improvement that users would like to have.

Display refresh burns battery on e-ink tag. Display refresh burns battery on e-ink tag. Price tags refresh every 10 minutes even when nothing changed, and CPU wakeups take battery life from 5 years to 8 months. It should only wake up when price differs.
Login with student ID number. Login with student ID number. Students forget the mail address they signed up with. Let them use their student ID at login as well, the password stays the same.

Error message shows another customer's order number. Error message shows another customer's order number. Trying to pay gave me "order 88213 for customer MK is locked". That isn't my order or my initials, and I should not have access to another person's account data.

Add to calendar button adds wrong day. Add to calendar button adds wrong day. That "add to calendar" option adds training to a day before if you are west of UTC. It is a shipped option, so it should already work, but date math ignores your offset.

Lock screen shows diagnosis in push notification. Lock screen shows diagnosis in push notification. Clinic app notifications include the test name and result in the preview text, even with the phone locked. Anyone who picks up my phone can read that private medical data, and I cannot find a setting to turn it off. This is a privacy problem.

Manual mode switch ignored by thermostat. Manual mode switch ignored by thermostat. Manual mode on thermostat page says on, but heating follows its schedule anyway. Guide describes it correctly, firmware just ignores this switch.

Appointment reminders stopped for my account. Appointment reminders stopped for my account. I used to get a text one day before each visit, then they just stopped in spring. I missed a visit and got charged. I checked, notifications are switched on.

Not a bug, just a wish: remember my filters. Not a bug, just a wish: remember my filters. When I come back to the orders page all my filters are back to default, which is how it was designed I suppose. I would prefer it to remember them per user.

Chat notification when the nightly build fails. Chat notification when the nightly build fails. Nobody reads the failure mails any more. Posting a short line with a link to the team channel would get eyes on it sooner.

Overtime hours rounded down on night shifts. Overtime hours rounded down on night shifts. 7.5 overtime hours get stored as 7 on the timesheet when the employee works nights. Day shift entries keep their decimals, only the night rule does this.
